Description: The scope of this tender is to procure a framework agreement, which enables DMI to purchase meteorological weather balloons over a four-year period. The weather balloons will be used for radiosonde measurements which will be conducted from DMI’s manually operated radiosonde stations (four in Greenland and three established onboard ships sailing between Denmark and Greenland). The deliveries will consist of meteorological weather balloons with necks.
